title: Westlake Chemical Partners LP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Westlake Chemical Partners LP filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Jonathan H. Baksht as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective June 15, 2026. Mr. Baksht will succeed M. Steven Bender, who is retiring. The filing is dated April 20, 2026.
key_points: Jonathan H. Baksht, age 51, appointed Senior Vice President and CFO of Westlake Chemical Partners GP LLC, effective June 15, 2026
Mr. Baksht will also serve as Senior Vice President and CFO of Westlake Corporation (indirect parent company) effective same date
Mr. Baksht previously served as Executive Vice President and CFO of Fortune Brands Innovations from May 2025 to March 2026
Outgoing CFO M. Steven Bender will retire from the Board and transition to Special Advisor to the President, effective June 15, 2026
The company (WLKP) trades on the New York Stock Exchange
This is a routine corporate governance filing under Items 5.02 and 7.01 of Form 8-K
